name: Buff Doge vs. Cheems
look: On a plain white background, a Shiba Inu head sits on a hugely muscular, bodybuilder body standing tall on the left, while on the right a small, chubby Shiba Inu sits hunched with a blue tear on its face. Blank space surrounds both dogs for captions.
use: The buff dog stands for a strong, impressive version of something, often from the past, and the small crying dog for its weak modern counterpart, each with a label and a line showing the contrast.
slots: the strong version (label above the buff dog)
the weak version (label above the small dog)
what the strong one says or does (below the buff dog)
what the weak one says or does (below the small dog)
examples: Survives a fall down the stairs
Cracks when it sees the floor
I will finish everything on my list
I need a nap after answering one email
describe: muscular shiba inu next to a small crying shiba inu
buff dog with a bodybuilder body versus a sad little dog
strong swole dog compared to a weak sitting dog

then versus now with a ripped dog and a sad one
